Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision that occurred while the patient was turning left and was struck from the side.
Imaging and examination were consistent with a wrist fracture, and the patient was treated conservatively with
immobilization, pain management, and a structured rehabilitation program. Over the course of eight visits, treatment
followed a typical clinical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as pain, swelling, and range of motion
improved. Some examination findings are consistent with the reported fracture, while other tests, including
neurovascular and grip assessments, returned within normal limits. Records reviewed show no prior injury or
treatment involving the same body region. At this stage, it remanis unclear whether the fracture is directly attributable
to this incident, and further correlation with the imaging timeline is recommended. Billed services reflect a single
course of care without duplicate or repeated charges for the same procedures.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
